rerun_after_change: DEFERRED: opponent levels are baked into the headless ROM, and this agent is instructed never to run make. The retest belongs to the main agent's wave rebuild.
could_this_be_cooler: The concept is genuinely nice - Petal Blizzard as an ally-feeding move for Sap Sipper Deerling and Flower Veil Flabebe protecting the Grass allies - but this run shows the combo is fragile in practice: the AI correctly refuses Petal Blizzard whenever Flabebe is on the field, and the AI's own turn-1 pivot to Flabebe therefore switched the combo off permanently. The cheap fix that would make it fire is a second Sap Sipper/Grass-immune body, or moving Flower Veil's partner off the field slot Petal Blizzard wants. A concrete suggestion for a later pass: give Flabebe Grassy Terrain instead of Pollen Puff so the Grass theme has a field effect the whole team shares and Deerling's Seed Bomb gets a real payoff, and let Petal Blizzard be safe because Flower Veil already blanks the ally hit conceptually. Not changed in this pass.
